question: After the workspace-root defect is fixed, should this public Claws update-planning command and JSON schema continue toward merge in the current stack?
rationale: The code defect has a narrow repair, but accepting and sequencing a new core CLI/schema on an entirely unmerged feature stack requires maintainer product intent.

options.title: Fix root contract and continue
options.body: Require a known workspace root, add regression coverage, and retain this draft in the Claws stack for normal maintainer review.

options.title: Pause until prerequisites settle
options.body: Keep the draft open but defer acceptance until the preceding Claws lifecycle and persistence contracts are approved.

options.title: Rework the update surface
options.body: Replace this command/schema slice if maintainers prefer a different product boundary for update planning.

recommendation.title: Fix root contract and continue
recommendation.body: Require a known workspace root, add regression coverage, and retain this draft in the Claws stack for normal maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision concerns acceptance and sequencing of a new core product surface rather than the narrow implementation repair.
